text:
Unprofessional service. We made a retainer. From the first day we went, you made us wait for an hour for a scan. We understand it might be a technical glitch, but when we went in for the scan, your staff took an hour. You couldn't do it, so you just kept doing it for ages. It took forever for someone to call for help. If having better technology doesn't improve the performance of your staff and your clinic, then the simple old-fashioned dental impressions seem right for you. It's not a waste of time. Even if the technology is good, if you can't or don't get it, it's kind of pointless.

This matter is over. We paid, you didn't return our ID card, you called to inform us. I think it might have been our fault for not checking ours before leaving, but you informed us, so we went to get it. When we went to get it, you gave it to someone else. So confusing. So careless. You didn't check the customer's name, and that's an ID card, not a toy ticket. You gave the customer careless treatment. If something gets damaged, will you be held responsible? We spent two days getting it. Then, on the day we came to get our retainer, you made an appointment. We called and you said, "Oh, come on in." We went, and halfway through, you called to say the lab hadn't sent it yet.


I asked you, you said you could have come, and we were already here. Did we waste our time? We're all grown up now, so we should know how valuable time is. So, we were leaving, and you texted us saying you'd be back in two days, and we said we'd pick it up. When we arrived for our second appointment, I asked if you were sure.
You said you were, but you wasted my time by telling me the lab would deliver it. But you asked if I'd pick it up myself or have it delivered. I said I would. We made an appointment, called, and the lab said it would be delivered, but you didn't ask for my address.
If I hadn't called today, would I have known? Please be professional. These things have happened to me, and you know it in your heart. I'm not happy with the service. I think I'm quite patient. It might have been my fault, but you shouldn't have
caused this. It's only one thing, but it's almost always the case when I'm serving customers. I want you to fix this. It's really frustrating when you encounter something like this. Let's use this as a learning opportunity, and don't let it happen to anyone else. Thank you.

- The staff were polite.

Personally, I think one visit was enough.
